reproduction.cell_comparison_command: for fixture in normal hostile; do python3 -B crates/searchright-prisma/examples/compare_imported_table.py /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/source/$fixture.html /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/docx/$fixture.docx; done
commands: for fixture in normal hostile; do /usr/bin/sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)(allow network* (local unix-socket))' /Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/lo-profile --headless --convert-to 'docx:Office Open XML Text' --outdir /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/docx /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/source/$fixture.html; done

for fixture in normal hostile; do /usr/bin/sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)(allow network* (local unix-socket))' /Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/lo-profile --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/docx-pdf /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/docx/$fixture.docx; pdftoppm -scale-to 1500 -png /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/docx-pdf/$fixture.pdf /tmp/searchright-reporting-evidence.9dNAiz/png/docx-$fixture-final; done
reproduction.note: Each command was observed individually for conversion success and followed by artifact and text checks; LibreOffice process exit alone is insufficient. Reproduction should use a fresh temporary directory and isolated profile.
